title: Explicit precomputed root-extraction sink channel preserving legacy residual ordering

shared_contract_change.minimum_change: add root_sink_provider_t and optional hydraulic_evaluation_context_t%root_sink pointer
shared_contract_change.reason: F-SI owns the soil-water solver service/evaluation context; F-KT remains consumer of candidate/result semantics only

legacy_arithmetic_contract.reason: folding qrot into sink can change floating-point association and therefore violates exact reference identity

provider_contract.fsi11_production_binding: precomputed qrot-style per-node root extraction sink

headcalc_binding.evaluation_frequency: once at solve entry for admitted swkimpl=0 profile
headcalc_binding.storage: worker/job-local or automatic root-sink vector for the active solve
headcalc_binding.residual_use: root_sink_term(node) returns the precomputed provider value at the exact legacy qrot addition site
headcalc_binding.legacy_route: unchanged when no explicit source/sink provider is active
headcalc_binding.fsi10_root_inactive_route: no root provider means zero root sink on explicit provider route

admitted_profile.constitutive: qualified F-SI09 corrected B1.10 default-MvG provider
admitted_profile.root_extraction: precomputed qrot-style sink, constant during the solve
